name: SecretField
description:
SecretInput bound to a form field holding a `SecretValue`: use it inside
`form.AppField`. The schema decides when a secret is required (`secretWillBeSet`).
signature: ({ label, hint, optional, required, width, disabled, secretName, className }: SecretFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting text in the field’s reserved message slot. Validation errors take precedence.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows the optional-field indication without changing validation.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: secretName
props.description: Names the secret for its buttons ("community").

props.name: width
props.description: Available width or named width tier.
